Game Overview

Color Box Ship is a casual game built around navigate your ship to catch falling squares, racing against the clock to prevent them from splashing into the water. With vibrant colors and simple controls, refine your skills, unlock powerful upgrades, and test your reflexes in this fast-paced, addictive challenge. How long can you survive?
